alternative_explanations: Country coverage and preliminary source data may change the aggregate in the next flash estimate.
Cross-country composition can move the aggregate without uniform domestic conditions.
analysis.behavioral_readout: The aggregate indicates a quarterly pickup in output, but the release lacks a completed expenditure or income breakdown, so it cannot yet be translated into a household or firm choice.
caveats: Preliminary data are incomplete and explicitly subject to revision.
Growth is volume-based and seasonally/calendar adjusted.
changes: Euro area quarterly growth rose from 0.0% in Q1 to 0.4% in Q2; EU growth rose from 0.1% to 0.5%.
Euro area year-on-year growth rose to 1.0% from 0.5%.
The estimate covers data from 19 Member States, representing 96% of euro-area GDP.
analysis.headline: Euro area GDP rose 0.4% quarter-on-quarter in Q2 after no growth in Q1, but the first flash estimate is incomplete and subject to revision.
implications: Inference: this is evidence of a short-term activity pickup, not yet of a durable broad-based growth trend.
verification_needed: Eurostat's Q2 GDP t+45 flash estimate on 14 August 2026.
